title: Brazil's Lula backs new oil, gas drilling in western Amazon
summary: Brazilian oil giant Petrobras announced Wednesday the drilling of new wells at an oil and gas field in the Amazon rainforest for the first time in a decade, at an event attended by President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva.
